'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] [[dismissal (employment)|dismisses]] [[Valerii Zaluzhnyi]] from the post of [[Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine|Commander-in-Chief]] of the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine]], following months of rumors about a disagreement between Zelenskyy and Zaluzhnyi. [[Commander of the Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ground Forces commander]] [[Oleksandr Syrskyi]] is appointed Commander-in-Chief to replace Zaluzhnyi. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68244813 (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Abbas al-Dabs, regional Hezbollah commander, suspected by Israeli intelligence of collaborating with [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|IRGC officers]] on building Iranian-funded air defenses in Syria, is assassinated in an IDF drone strike in [[Nabatieh]], Lebanon. [https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-drone-strikes-car-south-lebanons-nabatieh (New Arab)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20240208175602/https://www.jpost.com//middle-east/article-716583 (JPost)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Pakistani general election]] 
**[[Pakistanis]] elect members of the [[National Assembly of Pakistan|16th National Assembly]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/multiple-challenges-face-winner-pakistans-upcoming-general-election-2024-02-06/ (Reuters)]
**[[Cellular network|Mobile phone services]] are temporarily suspended and thousands of [[Pakistan Army|troops]] are deployed to protect [[polling station]]s during the [[2024 Pakistani general election]] as five policemen are killed in a [[bomb]]ing targeting a patrol in [[Kulachi]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], and two children are killed in a bombing at a [[polling station]] in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-votes-amid-polarisation-militant-attacks-economic-crisis-2024-02-07/ (Reuters)]
*''[[Trump v. Anderson]]''
**The [[Supreme Court of the United States|US Supreme Court]] hears arguments on whether the [[Colorado Supreme Court]] had the authority to exclude former [[President of the United States|US President]] [[Donald Trump]] from the [[Colorado]] presidential primary ballot, for allegedly violating Section 3 of the [[Fourteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/section-3-14th-amendment-us-constitution-trump-2024-ballot/ (CBS News)]

*[[NASA]]'s [[Plankton, Aerosol, Cloud, ocean Ecosystem|PACE]] mission is launched aboard a [[Falcon 9]] rocket at [[Cape Canaveral Space Force Station]] in [[Florida]], [[United States]], to study [[Earth]]'s ocean and atmosphere.
